author: bardic-inspiration
name: Shrine of Seals
summary: Five floor seals in the cult's shrine; each wrong one stepped on releases a swarm of bugs.

parts.text: Five round stone seals are set in the floor, each carved with a different sigil, and each humming faintly. The far door has no handle, only a sixth, empty socket.

Only the seal carved with an open eye is safe; stepping on it opens the door. The answer is written in the cult's ledger in the Ritual Chamber, and the {ref:creature/spy} from the Greencheck knows it. Each time a creature steps on a wrong seal, roll on the table: the seal cracks and the bugs inside pour out.

parts.title: The Seals
parts.text:
| Seal | Sigil | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A closed hand | Bugs |
| 2 | A broken chain | Bugs |
| 3 | An open eye | The door opens |
| 4 | A crossed-out line | Bugs |
| 5 | A candle | Bugs |
